[CAMERA & COMPOSITION]
Vertical 9:16 mobile POV video. High-angle perspective (35-degree downward tilt) filmed by someone standing beside the workbench in a printing workshop, looking down across the cutting table. Natural handheld camera breathing and responsive motion tracking the presenter's hands, authentic TikTok behind-the-scenes (BTS) workshop documentary style.

[ENVIRONMENT & ATMOSPHERE]
An active, bustling industrial paper printing workshop (xưởng in). In background: commercial paper cutting machine, stacks and pallets of paper reams under bright workshop lighting. On the table: a massive stack of heavyweight textured paper reams wrapped in white paper.

[SUBJECT & APPEARANCE]
Young East Asian female artisan matching <IMAGE_REF_0> wearing the casual loungewear top in <IMAGE_REF_1>. Standing to the left of the cutting table, leaning forward energetically over the materials.

[ACTION & TIMECODE]
00:00 - 00:03: She excitedly lifts and unfolds a large white packaging wrapper covering a thick ream of textured art paper, flipping it open onto the workbench.
00:03 - 00:07: She smooths the packaging paper flat across the ream, runs her fingers over the rich textured matte art paper, leaning in enthusiastically while speaking to the camera.
00:07 - 00:10: She pats the edges of the paper stack, then holds up a printed sheet of red Lunar New Year envelopes (bao lì xì Tết) to display the vivid red and gold print under the light, smiling brightly.

[AUDIO & DIALOGUE]
Lively spoken Vietnamese dialogue delivered with enthusiastic artisan cadence: "Có ai lấy giấy mỹ thuật Cordenons này in bao lì xì Tết chưa?". Background features ambient print shop workshop sounds and a catchy energetic lo-fi beat.
